legal.draftNotice: Draft – to be reviewed by legal counsel before public launch.
termsBody: Allingo provides test-prep tools and an AI tutor for personal study. Practice tests are written by Allingo and are not official ETS, Cambridge, JF/JEES or Hanban exams.
You are responsible for keeping your account secure and must not share paid accounts.
Results and estimated scores are for reference only and do not replace official certificates.
AI-generated content may contain mistakes; verify with a teacher when needed.
Paid plans, refunds and AI credits follow the pricing policy published at the time of purchase.
privacyBody: We collect your email/phone, study progress, answers and recordings (when you consent to voice processing) to provide the service.
Essays and recordings are stored in a private bucket, accessed only via short-lived signed URLs, and deleted after 90 days (Free) or 365 days (Pro).
Content sent to AI models never includes your name, email or phone number.
You can request account deletion in Settings; deletion completes within 72 hours, and billing records are retained in anonymized form as required by law.
We comply with Vietnam's Decree 13/2023/ND-CP on personal data protection.

schedule.reminderHint: Sent by push/email per your notification settings; skipped if you already studied that day.
schedule.timezoneHint: Defaults to your browser – used for study days, streaks and reminders.

diagnostic.title: Placement diagnostic
diagnostic.desc: About 25–30 minutes so Allingo knows your current level in each skill.
diagnostic.skip: Skip and create my plan now

length.title: ≈ 30 questions
length.desc: Covers Parts 1–7, one question per screen.

adaptive.title: Adaptive
adaptive.desc: 2 correct in a row → harder questions; 2 wrong → easier.

noFeedback.title: No per-question marks
noFeedback.desc: Results and a feasible target appear at the end.

errors.target: Target score must be between 10 and 990.
errors.exam_past: The exam date must be after today.
errors.exam_tooFar: The exam date must be within the next 2 years.
errors.weekly: Minutes per week must be between {min} and {max}.
errors.days: Pick at least one study day.

diagnostic.title: Diagnostic test
diagnostic.introDesc: A short adaptive test to estimate your current score and strengths/weaknesses by skill.
diagnostic.introTime: About 25–30 minutes, ≈ 30 questions across Parts 1–7. Reloading the page resumes the current question.
diagnostic.introAdaptive: Difficulty adapts to your answers: 2 correct in a row → harder, 2 wrong → easier.
diagnostic.introNoFeedback: No right/wrong shown per question. The result is an estimate with a score range.
diagnostic.groupRemaining: {count, plural, =1 {1 more question} other {# more questions}} on this passage

directions.part1: Look at the picture and listen to four statements (A–D). Choose the one that best describes it – they are not printed.
directions.part2: Listen to a question or statement and three responses (A–C). Choose the best response – it is not printed.

diagnostic.noFeedbackHint: Pick an answer and press Next – no right/wrong per question.
diagnostic.resultDesc: Estimated from {count, plural, =1 {1 answered question} other {# answered questions}}.
diagnostic.estimateNote: Scores are estimates from a short diagnostic (not official ETS scores); the range narrows as you take more tests.
diagnostic.masteryNone: Not enough data by sub-skill yet.

reason.feasible: With {hours} h/week over {weeks} weeks, your target {desired} is within reach (projected ≈ {suggested}).
reason.stretch: With {hours} h/week you're projected to reach ≈ {suggested} in {weeks} weeks. Reaching {desired} needs about {required} h/week.
reason.unreachable: {desired} is hard to reach before exam day even at maximum study time; projected ≈ {suggested} at {hours} h/week.
reason.no_exam_date: No exam date: with {hours} h/week you're projected to reach ≈ {suggested} after {weeks} weeks.
reason.no_target: No target set: with {hours} h/week over {weeks} weeks you're projected to reach ≈ {suggested}.

diagnostic.setupPlan: Build a plan from this result

plan.title: Study plan
plan.emptyTitle: You don't have a plan yet
plan.emptyDesc: Complete the 4-step onboarding and the diagnostic to get a personal schedule until exam day.
plan.regenerateDesc: Allingo re-arranges the remaining weeks using your latest target, exam date and mastery. Completed work stays in your history.
plan.regenerateQueued: Regenerating your plan – this page updates when it's ready.
plan.regenerateError: Couldn't regenerate the plan. Please try again later.
plan.checkinDue: Time for your weekly check-in – tell Allingo how this week went to adjust next week.
plan.fullTestEvery: Full mock test every {count, plural, =1 {week} other {# weeks}} on your plan
plan.examCountdown: {count, plural, =1 {1 day} other {# days}} to exam day
plan.noExamHint: No exam date – add one in onboarding to see a countdown.
plan.takeDiagnostic: Take the diagnostic to find your current level
plan.dragHint: Drag tasks to another day of the week, or use the ⋯ menu → “Move to…”.

moveError.sameWeek: Tasks can only move within the same week.
moveError.past: Can't move a task to a past day.
moveError.notPending: Only tasks not done yet can be moved.
moveError.generic: Couldn't change the day. Please try again.

plan.lockedDesc: The {phase} week ({range}) is part of Pro. The Free plan previews the current week.
plan.srsDue: {count, plural, =0 {no cards due} =1 {1 card due} other {# cards due}}

evidence.daily_vocab: Daily review keeps new words fresh.
evidence.weekly_checkin: Weekly check-in to adjust next week.
evidence.cadence_full_test: Mock test every {every_weeks} weeks to measure progress.
evidence.final_simulation: Final week: full mock test before the exam.
evidence.weak_section: {section} needs work (mastery ~{mastery_pct}%), so it gets more practice.

adjust.title: Adjust your plan
adjust.instructionTitle: Ask for a change in plain words
adjust.placeholder: E.g. “I'm busy this Wednesday, move it to the weekend” or “cut next week down to 2 hours”.
adjust.creditHint: AI drafts a proposal – uses AI credits; Allingo checks every constraint before you can apply it.
adjust.queued: Creating a proposal – it will appear here when ready.
adjust.noCredits: Not enough AI credits to create a proposal.

refusal.generic: That request can't be used to adjust the plan. Describe the schedule change you want.
refusal.injection: The request contains content that isn't allowed. Describe the schedule change you want.
refusal.off_topic: The request isn't about your study schedule.
refusal.unavailable: The content checker is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
refusal.answer_leak: That request isn't a plan adjustment.

proposal.pendingHint: AI is drafting – Allingo checks the constraints before showing it…
proposal.failedHint: Couldn't create a proposal. Check in again or send another request.
proposal.maxMinutes: Budget {budget} min · you're free for at most {max} min
proposal.violationsTitle: This proposal breaks a constraint, so it can't be applied

violation.invalid_op: Invalid change or reference to content that doesn't exist.
violation.unknown_task: Refers to a task that isn't in your plan.
violation.task_not_editable: Completed or past tasks can't be changed.
violation.past_date: Can't schedule tasks on past days.
violation.outside_week: Only the allowed week can change (next week after a check-in).
violation.after_exam: Can't schedule tasks after exam day.
violation.reduce_too_much: Shortens a task by more than half.
violation.no_target_date: No suitable study day left to move tasks to.
violation.cannot_reduce: Can't reduce to the time you said you have.
violation.over_availability: Exceeds the free time you entered for next week.
violation.multiple_full_tests: More than one full mock test in a week.

proposal.applyConflict: Couldn't apply – on the latest data the proposal is “{status}”.

today.title: Today

today.streakStart: Study today to start a streak.
today.noPlanDesc: Build a plan so you always know exactly what to study each day.
today.cardNoPlanDesc: 4 steps + a 25–30 minute diagnostic → a weekly schedule with concrete daily tasks.
today.checkinDesc: How did this week go? Allingo will suggest changes for next week.
today.allDone: All of today's tasks are done – great job!
today.restDesc: Nothing scheduled today. You can still practice if you like.
today.overdueDesc: Unfinished tasks from previous days – they expire after 3 days.
today.quickDesc: The most important {minutes} minutes for today:
today.warmup: Warm-up: {minutes} minutes of vocabulary review before practice.
